knownGap.what: The generated database password was not persisted. The storage step of the provisioning script crashed after the `supabase projects create` call had already succeeded, so the password — which existed only in that one shell invocation's environment — was lost rather than written to the intended gitignored recovery file.
knownGap.exposure: None. The password was never printed to output, never logged, and never committed. It simply no longer exists anywhere.
knownGap.impact: No impact on CLI-driven operations (this link, any future `supabase functions deploy`, RLS/auth work) since those authenticate via the CLI's own access token, not the database password. Anything that opens a direct Postgres connection or runs `supabase db push` needs the database password and will fail until it is reset.
knownGap.remediation: A human operator resets it from the Supabase dashboard: Project Settings -> Database -> Reset database password, for project ref cjdxtakgmnzwixrajjry. Recorded as B3's remaining productionActions entry in release/backlog.json.
